name: Sprout Step
description: Step from a seed point of space that sprouts a second footing a pace away.

name: Graft Palm
description: Strike with a palm grafted onto a fold of space so it lands from where the foe is weakest.

name: Vein Sense
description: Feel the living pulse of bodies near and far through the folds of space between them.

name: Seed Bind
description: Plant seeds of space in the ground that sprout into holds about a foe's legs.

name: Graft Cut
description: Graft a cutting edge of folded space onto the hand and slice through guard and skin.

name: Cradle Shell
description: Hold a living cradle of folded space about the user that grows thicker where it is struck.

name: Mending Reach
description: Reach across a fold of space to an ally and knit their wounds with the life stream.

name: Spined Rift
description: Open a rift whose edges grow long spines that pierce whatever stands before it.

name: Thorn Tempest
description: Scatter seeds of space over the field that burst into tearing thorns of force.

name: Living Fold
description: streams: Space + Life; fold a garden of living space over the field that wounds the foes and mends the user's allies together.

name: Null Step
description: Empty the space ahead of the foot and step across the emptiness in a single pace.

name: Absent Palm
description: Strike with a palm that leaves nothing in the space it crosses and meets no resistance.

name: Absence Sense
description: Feel the hole that a hidden body leaves in the space about it and mark where it stands.

name: Voided Grip
description: Empty the space about a foe's limbs so they cannot find anything to push against.

name: Erase Cut
description: Cut a line out of the space between hand and foe so the stroke arrives with no travel.

name: Dim Guard
description: Empty a thick band of space before the body so a blow has nothing to cross on.

name: Null Poise
description: Hold the user's own space quiet and empty so every move inside it is clean and sure.

name: Absence Lance
description: Drive a lance of emptied space through the guard so it leaves a hole where it passes.

name: Null Veil
description: Wrap the body in emptied space where lesser blows find nothing to strike.

name: Null Rend
description: Empty the space within a foe's body so that no armor or ward can turn the loss.

name: Absent Fold
description: streams: Space + Void; fold a wide field in upon itself until it holds nothing and all that stood inside it is gone.

name: Moment Step
description: Step into the place the body will stand one breath hence and arrive there early.

name: Instant Palm
description: Strike so the palm lands before the foe's guard has finished its rise.

name: Tempo Sense
description: Read the beat of a foe's motion across the space between them and know the next move.

name: Delay Hold
description: Stretch a foe's moment so each motion they make is a breath late.

name: Echo Cut
description: Cut once and let the same cut fall again from the moment just gone.

name: Hour Guard
description: Hold a guard in the moment before the blow lands so its force is already spent.

name: Stilled Lance
description: Freeze a lance in space for a heartbeat then loose it with all its stored speed.

name: Reversed Step
description: Step back to the place the body stood a moment ago and leave a strike to fall on empty ground.

name: Moment Sever
description: Cut the foe from the flow of their own moment and hold them fixed while the blow lands.

name: Instant Fold
description: streams: Space + Time; fold distance and duration together so the user strikes the whole field in the span of one heartbeat.
